Polypropylene prices rise globally following outbreak of Middle East war The Middle East accounts for close to 25% of global PP and polyethylene exports, according to S&P Global Energy data. Polypropylene is a type of plastic used to make everything from food containers and water bottles to household appliances and automotive parts. Asian prices have seen the most significant increase. Platts assessed the PP injection CFR Far East Asia spot price at $1,180/mt, up $330/mt since March 2.
